carrot hamburg steak!

Cheese! Cheese, cheese, chee... se.

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Where's my grated parmesan cheese?! 
...C-Could it be... back at the dorm...?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
M-My cheese hamburg steak that I worked so 
hard for...
